reviews.text:
They completely changed the UI for the worse and now not only are features removed for no reason. Everything is hidden behind a million menus that pop up without your control, everything is considerably more cramped and awkward to navigate and draw on.

Its filled with bugs and glitches too. It takes me like 4 times as long now to get what i usually have to get done on it. Use any other paint app, this one will be a detriment if you use art as a business.

Also the terrible PR team loves to patronize their users by just calling it “a readjustment period” as if everyone using it doesnt realize that this is an objectively worse update.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text:
This latest UX update has completely broken the app. Selecting brushes is a hassle, and does not always work. Brushes are missing. Drawing assist does not work.

Worst of all, the canvas does not reliably register strokes. Strip away all other features, and the core function of this app, drawing with your finger, if fundamentally broken.

For what is the supposed to be the best, most user friendly and reliable drawing app, this is a complete misstep.

It feels like whoever created the original app has been long removed from the app team, and, were I to hazard a guess, someone, thinking they were quite clever, tried to vibe code an update.

If you haven’t dropped the money on the app, don’t bother. Get anything else. Use the default notepad.

reviews.title: Who approved this update?
reviews.text: This update is the epitome of  prioritizing form over function. Who approved of these UI changes? Certainly no artist. It makes me think someone with money and a desire for things to look pretty outbid the rational thinkers at whatever meeting decided these changes. Things I didn't even realize could break, have broken. The color fill lags, making a straight line requires three extra steps (and increasing patience for every consecutive line), the color wheel GLOWS for some godforsaken reason (seriously, whose genius idea was it to make the color picker change colors while picking a color?!), there's now a white line surrounding the canvas and every action notification covers the newly-cramped menu icons requiring you to wait for it to disappear every single time before clicking anything. I could go on but I'd reach the review's character limit. This is an abysmal update to the point I've downloaded another app to use on my phone instead. Color history and layer visibility are the only good things to come from this update.

That traded a beautiful, streamlined work station that had everything you needed a single click away; with a series of jumpy, bouncy, hidden off screen boxes that take multiple interactions with multiple different buttons now to get to. And after the effort is put in to equip something, or add a layer, or try to color drop, it will work with 10% accuracy at best, and have a laggy buggy performance  Its so unfortunate as like I said before I love procreate. But I think Ill be deleting it soon if its not restored to its former glory...

reviews.title: Horrible Update
reviews.text: I was initially excited to check out the new brushes and everything, but have become severely disappointed after working on a canvas. The UI is terrible, the gallery is clunky with only two columns instead of 3, the old top bar in canvas was much better, I can’t even gaussian blur under 1% anymore, which was often useful for smaller details and canvases. The worst part, and the main reason for the rating, is the colordrop changes. I can’t adjust the percentage as well as before, needing multiple drops until it’s adjusted enough. The continue filling barely works, and 80% of the time I switch to previous color instead of dropping at all! None of which are issues I had before the update.

reviews.title: New update issues
reviews.text:
Longtime user here. I use this app exclusively for drawing. This update has some QOL issues, some minor and some so egregious you’d think there was no beta testing period. 

Many things take longer to do, like one extra tap or swipe. The smooth feeling of switching layers, colors, etc is gone. That’s my minor complaint. 

The major stuff:
